selectionReview.wording: Attempt FIVE questions from Section A and ONE question from Section B.
selectionReview.reason: Retain every task in all seven Section A and all four Section B questions. The exam choice limit does not remove practice content.
This quantifies the theorem to be proved; there is no finite list of alternative tasks.

selectionReview.wording: selected from ten people; one particular person; digits 3 to 9 inclusive
selectionReview.reason: The people and digits define mathematical counting scenarios, not printed answer-choice menus. Each requested count is one task.

notes: All 74 tasks and all 550 offered marks are retained; the candidate may attempt 300 marks. No task-internal finite answer pool needs expansion.
Required lists, both roots, coordinate pairs, complete proofs and graphs remain complete responses.
Q1(b)(i) uses 10+5 and Q11(b)(i) uses 10+5+5 scoring components inside their published tasks. Alternative methods never add marks.
Strict hit-or-miss and restricted award tables are represented by their exact permitted marks. General deduction routes retain blunder −3, slip/misreading −1, attempt floors and worthless zero.
Q9 vector constructions and single-resultant answers have distinct scoring methods and tolerances. All original diagrams remain available at source size.
Source printing errors and the omitted written converse are explained without changing the official solution images.
